notes: 69685: after Barca's attack into the box (~69620-69690) the Athletic keeper holds the ball and walks with it in his hands to the edge of the box (69850), then drops it and plays it short to a teammate (~69864). That is live distribution, not a set piece (a free kick or goal kick would have been placed near the goal), so A from the start of the piece. Athletic then play it out to the top touchline (~70016) and dribble up the line toward halfway. 70132: a Barca player challenges at the ball by the touchline near halfway, the ball runs loose and all players stop at once (plv drops to ~1). Athletic pick up the ball and stand with it, and there are long replays/split-screen of the Lewandowski box incident and Raphinha arguing with the referee. Play is stopped (foul or VAR check), so D until the end of the piece with no restart seen.
